MEMORANDUM
To: Board of [AUTHORITY]
From: Staff
Re: Proposed taxable revenue bond and PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT] in [COUNTY]

Staff proposes a $12,000,000 taxable revenue bond with a 20-year term at a 4.50% fixed rate. Level monthly payments are $75,918, or $911,015 annually. Projected net operating income of $1,500,000 gives debt service coverage of 1.65x. Bond par equals 44.4% of the $27,000,000 total capital investment: $18,000,000 real property and $9,000,000 equipment.

The PILOT applies to the real property only. Full annual tax is $205,200 (40% assessment on $18,000,000 at 28.5 mills). Years 1 through 5 are fully abated; abatement then falls 10 points per year, reaching 0% in year 15. The company pays $41,040 in year 7. Over years 1 through 15, abated taxes total $1,949,400, company PILOT payments total $1,128,600, and the present value of abatement at 5.0% is $1,496,856.

The project supports 150 full-time jobs at an average wage of $52,000, or $7,800,000 in annual payroll. Abatement equals $12,996 per job.

Note on ambiguity: the PILOT is computed on real property only, and abated amounts are discounted with year 1 at one period, as specified.
